You press Shift+Tab until the status bar reads `plan`.
The agent is now read-only: it reads files, runs shell commands to explore, and writes a plan file, but it can't edit or execute until you approve.
The plan file has an identity. A descriptive name (`migrate-auth-hash-calm-otter.md`, not random words) you can come back to.
